Ujjvalanīlamaṇi
bhakti. by Vallabhācārya (?) Oudh IX. 18 (an. C.). XXII. 120 (an. C.). Is this a mistake for U. n. maṇi of Rūpa ?

Ujjvalanīlamaṇikiraṇa
or u. kiraNa alaṁk. by Viśvanātha Cakravarttin. An epitome of U. n. maṇi. Vaṅgīya p.. 214-5.
Pt.. with partial Bengali versions, in a collection called Bhaktivartmapradarśaka-grantha, Calcutta, 1915. Another recension, ptd., Boaljur, Silchar, 1920. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1261-62.

Ujjvalanīlamaṇikiraṇaleśa
a further epitome of U. n. maṇi, by Viśvanātha Cakravarttin. AK. 318. BORI. D. XII. 37. C.. VII. 5. X. B. 5. 134. Dacca 2546. K. 531 B. L. 580. SSPC. I. G. 16. Vaṅgīya p.. 214-5 (3 mss.). Varendra 1059.

Ujjvalanīlamaṇiprasaṅga
kāvya. Tüb. 10 (not now in the University; sold to Otto Harrasowitz).

Ujjvalapaṇḍita
--Karaṇavṛttisandarbhasāgara, on the Kāyasthas of Orissa. Cuttack 14.

Ujjvalapadā
name of a.'s own C. on Sāhityakautūhala by Yaśasvikavi. IO. 1175.

Ujjvalamaṇi
--C. on Bhramaragītā. Rajapur 84.

Ujjvalarasakaṇa
a devotional poem on Rāmacandra by Sanātana. Oudh V. 26. XXI. 152. Such a work of Sanātana is not confirmed. See D., Vaiṣṇ. Faith an. Movement in Bengal.

Ujjvalarasavivaraṇa
